note: Reference Thom polynomials, computed independently of the Berczi-Szenes residue formula implemented in this repository. Used to constrain our own computation, never to replace it. Agreement at A_7 is what makes the failures of the paired and unpaired inequalities at d=7 a statement about mathematics rather than a bug. A_1 to A_3 are degenerate cases: deg Q_d = 0 there, so Q_d = 1 and the orbit fills the ambient space; they pin down the small end of the pipeline.
basis: Relative Chern classes. A term is the multiset of indices i of the c_i appearing, as a sorted list, so [1,1,1,5] means c_1^3 c_5.

tables.singularity: cup_{lambda} (x^2-lambda yz , y^2-lambda xz, z^2-lambda xy) = open in Sigma^3(l=0)
